columns.description: A unique system generated identifier for the detail record that is associated with the turnover declaration.

columns.name: DECL_HEADER_ID
columns.description: A unique system generated identifier for the header record that is associated with the turnover declaration. Foreign key identifier to JG_ZZ_AR_AP_TRNOVR_DECL_HDRS table.
